                      WHERE d.text_tsv @@ l::tsquery
                      LIMIT $11
                   ) capped) AS n
          FROM q, unnest(q.lexemes) AS l
      ), ranked AS (
        SELECT l, n,
               row_number() OVER (ORDER BY n ASC, l ASC) AS rn,
               COALESCE(sum(n) OVER (ORDER BY n ASC, l ASC
                                     ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND $12 PRECEDING), $13) AS prior

        -- anchoring on it would make the budget a fiction.
        SELECT string_agg(l, $14 ORDER BY n ASC, l ASC)::tsquery AS a
